title: Binance Beginner Guide From Sign Up to First Trade Step by Step
description:
✔ 20% Binance Fee Discount + $600 Bonus + $50 Payback Included
https://m.site.naver.com/23sjt

If you register through this link, the referral code will be automatically applied.

When registering via the app, use the 20% discount code: EN20OFFVIP

By signing up through this link, the 20% fee discount code will be automatically entered.

✔ Basic 20% Discount + Additional 25% Discount When Paying Fees with BNB!
: Please refer to the BNB discount video for more details.

🎁 Sign-Up Benefits Event 🎁
📌 Deposit 10 USDT and receive an additional 10 USDT bonus!
📌 Receive a $600 coupon

Existing users can also receive the 20% fee discount if they meet the following three conditions:

The invited person already has a registered Binance account.

The invited person has never accepted an invitation before.

The invited person has not traded or used any products on the Binance platform in the past 180 days.

A confirmation window will appear when the eligible invitee opens the link and logs in.

The binding will take effect once the invitee clicks [Bind Now].

asr.full_text: Hello! In this video, I will explain the basic ways to use Binance from start to finish and show you how to check whether the Binance referral 20% Trading Fee discount was properly applied. HOW TO CHECK If a Binance referral has been applied HOW TO CHECK IF A BINANCE REFERRAL HAS BEEN APPLY? First, when signing up it is highly recommended to apply a referral. This is because you receive a 20% trading fee discount. In addition, there is also a 600 dollar bonus benefit, so not applying it can be considered a loss. The method to check whether it is applied is very simple. If you access Binance through the link I provided, you will see it visually displayed on the left side of the screen. This means that when you access through my link, you receive a 20% trading fee cashback benefit and a $6,00 bonus benefit. If you see this screen when accessing the link, it means the referral has been applied correctly. If you signed up through a link without a referral? After signing up, if you have no trading history and wait for six months, you can manually enter the referral link and receive the benefits. Please keep this in mind, Binance sign-up process. Now let's return to the main topic and start with the sign-up process. First, enter the email address you will use. Any email is fine, but I recommend using Gmail. This is because trade notifications and deposit alerts will be sent to this email. It is more convenient to use an email you check often. After agreeing to the terms of service, you will see the Email Verification step. Go to your inbox. Copy the verification code and paste it in. If you do not receive the email, be sure to check your spam folder as well. Lastly you need to set a password. It must be at least 8 characters long and include at least one number and one uppercase letter. Once this is done, the signup process is complete. KYC verification process. Next is Identity verification, which appears immediately. If you is Identity verification, which appears immediately If you do not complete verification, you will face restrictions on deposits, withdrawals, and trading This step is required to use the exchange normally You can choose one of three types of identification A National ID card, Driver's License or Passport In this video, I will explain using a National ID card as an example. Next, you will choose the Verification Method. Please select the File Upload method instead of the QR code option. Then upload photos of the front and back of your ID card. After uploading, you will proceed to real-time Facial Verification. Align your face with the screen and follow the instructions such as blinking or turning your head left and right follow the instructions accordingly verification usually takes from five minutes up to one hour once identity verification is completed we will now move on to spot trading methods spot trading bot trading is very simple on the binance screen click trade and then spot for you. With market order enter the quantity and press buy and trade will be executed immediately. You can then see the coin in your wallet. Selling works in the same way, enter the quantity and press sell. Futures trading Now let's move on to futures trading. From the top menu click futures and enter the first futures trading menu. Scroll down slightly and you will see transfer futures trading uses a separate wallet from spot trading. It will be used to sell your stock. For which stock should you start trading? Try to select a stock which has been previously been sold and then select the stock. You see the link for the stock is on the top right. Select the stock that you want to sell. That stock has been previously sold and you'll see the drop down chart that says this is it. To close the trade open the trade menu on the top and scroll down, then check the funds back to the spot wallet first, then proceed with withdrawal. The default trading pair is usually BTCUSDT. You can select any coin you want to trade. For this example, we will use a low-priced coin. First, choose the margin mode, isolated or cross-margin Isolated margin only uses the funds allocated to that position Making risk management easier cross margin uses all available funds which can affect your entire account if losses occur for beginners Isolated Margin is recommended. Next is leverage setting. The default is x But beginners should start with 2X to 5X or lower. Higher leverage increases profits, but also increases losses and trading fees. Now select the order type. Market order or limit order. Market orders execute immediately, but have slightly higher fees. Limit orders. Allow you to set your desired price and execute when the price is reached. Choose based on market conditions. Finally choose your position direction. Long positions are used when you expect prices to rise. Short positions are used when you expect prices to fall. Once price will be increased to 5% This will prevent long market closings It's time to limit positions Short positions are used when you expect prices to rise And are used only once in short positions Once you do that your position will show up on the top right corner When closing a trade choose a trade between the market and the limit To do this set the desired closing price and, the position will close automatically when the price is reached. Market close exits immediately at the current price. Simply enter the quantity. This allows you to take profits or cut losses rapidly. In this video, we covered referral verification, KYC verification and futures trading from entry to exit. It may feel complicated at first, but after trying it a few times, you will get used to it. If this was video was helpful, please subscribe and like the video. Thank you. things that make a difference when trying to get into the same world with the same people.
